Would give a five, but...there must be a change in whoever manufactured this part. We had ordered this same part a few years ago and it fit exactly onto the shaft it needs to go on. However, with this one, it doesn’t slid on at all. There’s a 1000th of an inch difference (or less) in the Inner Diameter (ID) of the bushing from the previous part to this one.

Here’s how I fixed it. Take a half inch drill (fits perfectly) bit and run it on the inside of the part for about a minute or two while rotating the part at the same time. This ensures the ID is rounded out as evenly as possible. You will notice the smallest amount of metal powder appearing on the part and in your hand. Check the fit of the pulley onto the shaft. You may have to repeat this process a few times until the pulley fits perfectly onto the shaft AND spins freely as it should.

I replaced the squealing pulley on my Whirlpool Cabrio dryer with this replacement.  The plastic and the shape of the pulley look much more robust than the OEM pulley that came off the dryer.  Just like the OEM part, the center metal collar is fixed to the plastic outer wheel.  There is no bearing.  It's just metal collar grinding against metal axle.  So lube it generously and often.
